snippet.title: Women appear to make racist gestures outside apartment
snippet.description:
A doorbell camera showing women making monkey noises and gestures as they walked past an apartment where three Black Ole Miss students reportedly live has sparked outrage. The University of Mississippi condemned the “offensive” behavior and says it is investigating.

UPDATE: Alaina Kunes, one of the women identified in the video, sent a statement to CNN affiliate WMC apologizing and saying her actions were “insensitive, inappropriate, and deeply harmful.” Kunes said she did not know the residents' race, adding, “I would have never intentionally made those noises or gestures toward a person of color.”

snippet.title: Zeynep, Ali'nin Odasına Dalınca Manzaraya Şok Oldu! - Anne Yarısı 7. Bölüm
snippet.description:
Zeynep, Ali'nin odasına girdi. BAKLAVAYA DOYDUN MU?
Anne Yarısı 7. Bölümü izlemek için tıklayın: https://youtu.be/xcMg7DNhtcE

(10 Kasım 2026)

Ali, Zeynep’in Meryem’i öne sürerek velayet konusunda kendisini tehdit etmesiyle iyice çıkmaza girer. Zeynep karar vermesi için ona iki gün süre tanımıştır. Özcan herkesin içinde Nazlı ile evlendiklerini söyledikten sonra karısının elinden tutup oradan ayrılırlar. Kardeşine kıyamayan Kadir ertesi gün onları kaldıkları bağ evinden alarak konağa geri getirir. Ancak Altın buna şiddetle karşı çıkacaktır. Sibel, Songül’le ilişkisi olduğunu söyleyip Asım’dan yüklü bir miktar para ister. Çaresiz kalan Asım, Fidan’ın altınlarını çalarak ona verir. Ali’nin olumlu cevap vereceğine ve Ege’yle birlikte İzmir’e döneceğine inanan Zeynep çok mutludur. Ege’nin de çok sevineceğini düşünerek konuyu ona açtığında hiç beklemediği bir tavırla karşılaşır. Ali’nin ise kızından vazgeçmeye hiç niyeti yoktur. Annesini de ateşe atmadan bu işi kapamanın bir yolunu bulacaktır.

Sekiz yıl önce yaşanan büyük bir kaybın ardından yolları aynı çocuğun etrafında kesişen Ali ve Zeynep’in duygu yüklü hikayesini ekrana taşıyacak. Geçmişin sırları, velayet mücadelesi ve büyük fedakarlıklarla örülen dizi, izleyiciyi etkileyici bir yolculuğa çıkaracak.

snippet.title: Florida's Winter Is About To Be VERY Different...
snippet.description:
Y'all Call, a call from me whenever severe weather threatens your area: https://yallcall.app
📱 FREE WEATHERWISE RADAR APP: • iOS: https://apple.co/44wDDKH • Android: https://bit.ly/42RyZEu

Florida, this winter isn't about snow for y'all. It's about storms, and the ones I'm worried about most come in the middle of the night. Florida's big El Niño seasons have brought about three times as many strong tornadoes as every other season, and two out of every three people killed by a Florida tornado between November and April were killed at night.

This is my whole winter forecast for Florida, from the Panhandle to the Keys: the jet stream this El Niño stretches across the Gulf, how much rain it brings, the tornado setup, whether it gets cold, and what you can do right now so a storm at 3 in the morning doesn't catch you asleep.

snippet.title: The New NASA Mission to Find Life in the Universe, with Evgenya Shkolnik
snippet.description:
Make it yourself at lovable.com

Are there habitable worlds that look nothing like Earth? Neil deGrasse Tyson and comic co-host Matt Kirshen discuss NASA’s Habitable Worlds Observatory and its eventual search for life beyond our solar system with astrophysicist Evgenya Shkolnik.

Learn about SPARCS, a backpack-sized, 9-centimeter CubeSat telescope that studies the ultraviolet light of stars known to host planets. How did we go from zero known exoplanets to data showing the average star has at least one? What does “habitable” really mean? 

They break down the Goldilocks zone, why water must actually be present, and why habitable doesn’t mean inhabited. Is it bias to look for Earth-like life? They discuss biosignatures, extremophiles, and why we start with what we know. 

We explore the Habitable Worlds Observatory. You’ll learn about what instruments are planned and how those tools will help us locate habitable worlds and more. We discuss how UV light can erode atmospheres or fake biosignatures, why red dwarfs offer the most habitable real estate but are turbulent. Do planets need magnetic fields? Is there a way of detecting magnetic fields in far off solar systems? 

They also cover the roughly 6,000 known exoplanets, why most are still too faint and distant to study, and plans for a fleet of CubeSats to hunt for magnetic fields around habitable zone worlds. Finally, Neil reflects on the luxury of asking these questions, and how every answer widens the perimeter of our ignorance.

They break down the Goldilocks zone, why water must actually be present, and why habitable doesn’t mean inhabited. Is it bias to look for Earth-like life? They discuss biosignatures, extremophiles, and why we start with what we know. 

We explore the Habitable Worlds Observatory. You’ll learn about what instruments are planned and how those tools will help us locate habitable worlds and more. We discuss how UV light can erode atmospheres or fake biosignatures, why red dwarfs offer the most habitable real estate but are turbulent. Do planets need magnetic fields? Is there a way of detecting magnetic fields in far off solar systems? 

They also cover the roughly 6,000 known exoplanets, why most are still too faint and distant to study, and plans for a fleet of CubeSats to hunt for magnetic fields around habitable zone worlds. Finally, Neil reflects on the luxury of asking these questions, and how every answer widens the perimeter of our ignorance.

snippet.description:
“กฤต ชนนพัฒฐ์” สส.กล้าธรรม ดักรอต้อนรับนายกฯ อนุทิน หน้าอาคารรัฐสภา โดยไหว้ทักทายก่อนยืนกระซิบคุยกันพักหนึ่งอย่างเป็นกันเองต่อหน้าสื่อ ซึ่งเจ้าตัวเข้ามาที่สภาฯ เป็นเวลา 10 นาที ก่อนเดินทางออกไปภารกิจภายนอก

โดยก่อนหน้านี้เคยมีภาพปรากฏว่า สส.ชนนพัฒฐ์ เคยมารอส่งนายกฯ อนุทินที่รัฐสภาเช่นกันในช่วงสัปดาห์ที่ผ่านมา ท่ามกลางกระแสข่าวจับมือร่วมรัฐบาลกันในอนาคต

Welcome to our devotional family.

Listen to a melodious Shri Krishna bhajan in this video,

which will fill your mind with peace, devotion, and joy.
Our aim is to let the love of "Radhe Krishna" flow in every heart

and to let the echo of devotion resonate in every home.

--

🎶 Importance of Krishna Bhajan

Shri Krishna is the symbol of compassion, love, and righteousness.

Listening to or singing his bhajans—

Peaces the mind 🕊️

Purifies the soul 🌸

Brings positivity into life ✨

And increases love in the heart 💖

---

📿 Hare Krishna Mahamantra

"Hare Krishna Hare Krishna, Krishna Krishna Hare Hare.
Hare Rama Hare Rama, Rama Rama Hare Hare."

Chanting this mantra calms the mind and gives the soul an experience of divinity.

This mantra is the simplest way to connect us with God.

---

🌺 Krishna's Leelas

From stealing butter in his childhood to killing the snake Kaliya and teaching the Gita to Arjuna—
each pastime teaches us the message of life:

True power lies in devotion.

---

🎼 Our Bhajan Collection

👉 Bhakti Geet

Each bhajan immerses you in the love of Lord Krishna and calms the mind.

---

🌸 The Path of Devotion

Devotion is the simple path that leads directly to God.

When we chant Krishna's name with a true heart,
sorrows are dispelled and new light comes into our lives.

---

💫 Our Mission

We want the name of "Hare Krishna" to resonate in every home.
That's why we present new bhajans and kirtans daily.
